The implementation is complete and fully verified. Here's a summary of what I built:

## `/app/submission/main.py` (single file, 21 KB)

**Compiler (`compile`)** — strict config validation (exact key sets, integer domains with `bool` rejection, distinct rule IDs, 1–32 ranges with `-2048 ≤ low ≤ high ≤ 2048`, ≤2048 rules, ≤16384 total positions, fallback tree ≤255 nodes / ≤16 edges / feature < W), plus duplicate-key and NaN/Infinity rejection. Emits a compact program (~234 KiB worst case): scalars, rules sorted by ID, and the fallback tree flattened into a 4-tuple array.

**Stream engine** — the core is a multi-pattern shift-AND bitset automaton:
- One bit per (rule, position) slot, laid out in **ascending rule-ID order**, so low-bit iteration yields matches already in required output order.
- Per-feature masks `M[c]` for all 4097 signed values built at startup by an endpoint sweep (`on`/`off` bit accumulation), injection mask `I` (all position-0 bits), terminal mask `TM`.
- Per packet: `D = ((D<<1)|I) & M[c+2048]`, then `D & TM` enumerates every occurrence ending at `n` (overlaps, suffixes, cross-chunk, post-decision included); `start = n-k`.
- Per-flow bounded state only (D, n, matches, immutable decision, last-activity, direction, first-W features with cached fallback class) — no history retention.
- Idle expiry uses a lazy-deletion min-heap of `(last_activity, flow)` with amortized-O(1) rebuilds, so per-packet cost is a single comparison; expiring flows are collected into a set and emitted in ascending flow-ID order (this also fixed a duplicate-emission bug found by differential testing).
- Checkpoints encode `D` as base64 (worst case 2766 B/flow vs the 8192 B/flow budget) and rebuild the heap on restore.

**Verification performed**
- Public sanity: byte-exact `expected.jsonl` match (also under `env -i`, clean temp dir) and restart equivalence.
- ~700 randomized differential cases vs an independently written naive reference across three workload families, with interleaved checkpoint/restart cycles.
- Hand-computed scenario tests (overlap, priority/length/ID tie-breaks, earliest-completion, sign establishment, idle ordering + audit-after-expiry, zero padding, ID reuse, `idle_timeout=0`).
- Boundary tests: max time/flow/rule IDs, extreme priorities/classes, 1024-packet chunks, error on the last packet of a chunk, zero-spanning ranges, exact-timeout non-expiry; ~70 invalid config/event inputs producing exactly `{"error":"config"}`/`{"error":"event"}` with exit 2.
- Scale: 10⁶ packets × 16384 rule positions in ~4 s, 100 000 requests in ~1 s, combined worst case ~5 s, peak RSS ~46 MiB, 4096-flow checkpoints round-tripped identically.
